      What to do if redirects to other sites occur?

      posted on
      30.03.2025

      Notice Regarding Advertisements on Our Site

      Listen to audio version of this article
      Sponsored by
      0:00 / 1:02
      Instaread

      We understand that ads can sometimes be intrusive, and we strive to ensure a smooth browsing experience for all our users. However, if you come across an advertisement that redirects you to another website when clicked, please let us know!

      You can report such ads in our Discord server at the following link: Discord Report Channel, or in the chat on our website under the “Site Bugs” section: MangaRead Chat.

      Please note that we cannot directly control pop-up advertisements on the site, and even our advertisers have limited control over them. Ads are delivered through an auction-based system, which means that different ads may appear dynamically.

      To help us block unwanted ads, please provide us with the links to the websites they redirect you to. This will allow us to take action and prevent similar ads from appearing in the future.

      Thank you for your cooperation and support in making MangaRead a better experience for everyone.
